info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Streaming Subscriptions Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: The Cancel Streaming Subscriptions API allows users to effectively manage their streaming subscriptions by providing the ability to cancel them as needed. This endpoint facilitates the removal of active subscriptions, ensuring that users are no longer charged for services they no longer wish to use. Ideal for developers and service providers, this API supports seamless integration into applications that require subscription management features. Typical use cases include user account management systems and billing platforms.

delete.description: This operation allows you to cancel an existing subscription, effectively terminating the service associated with it. Use this endpoint to ensure that the subscription is no longer active and no further charges will be incurred.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details for canceling a subscription. It should include all necessary information required by the API to process the cancellation effectively.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelReques.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a subscription operation in the DELETE endpoint.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelRespon.title: Cancel Subscription Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the subscription after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the cancellation operation.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelRespon.description: Response schema for a successful subscription cancellation operation.
